en.html:
Here. The one place of perfect safety!

From his stance, Shishiku could hardly thrust downward. For a downward cut I would be excellent prey—but that cut he could not make.
en.text:

From his stance, Shishiku could hardly thrust downward. For a downward cut I would be excellent prey—but that cut he could not make.

ja.html:
ここだ。
　ここが唯一、完璧な安全地帯！

　獅子吼の構から、下向きに<ruby>刺突<rt>つき</rt></ruby>を繰り出すのは無理
がある。
　斬り下ろすならば好餌だが――しかし、それは成し
得ないのだ。

en.html:
Even as I sank into the mire of that bewildering blade, my eyes had barely managed to follow his right hand. Secretly, it had left his sword... to draw the short sword at his waist!

Jump up, move to either side: he would probably have finished me with a thrown short sword. Splendid sword trick. Splendid check.

But one escape remained. Down. Throw at me crouching here, and the short sword would only hit my helmet. Whatever skill he had, it could not pierce the gap at my throat. No line of fire. Skill could not supply one.

But one escape remained. Down. Throw at me crouching here, and the short sword would only hit my helmet. Whatever skill he had, it could not pierce the gap at my throat. No line of fire. Skill could not supply one.

ja.html:
眩惑の沼に落とされゆく<ruby>最中<rt>さなか</rt></ruby>、俺の眼は辛うじて、
獅子吼の右手の行方を追っていた。
　それは密かに、太刀から外され……腰の脇差を引き
抜こうとしていた……！

　上へ飛ぼうと左右へ身を振ろうと、おそらく獅子吼
は脇差の投擲によって俺を仕留めたであろう。
　見事な妖剣、見事な<ruby>王手<rt>チェック</rt></ruby>だ。

　が、唯一。下方にのみ退路を残した。
　しゃがみ込んだ俺に向かって脇差を投げても、兜に
当たるだけだ。いかに巧妙な手業があろうと、喉元の
間隙を穿つ事はできない。<ruby>射線<rt>・・</rt></ruby>が通らないのだから。

en.html: As for cutting down, his long sword was now in his left hand alone. A one-handed cut could not possibly break through the armor. The advantage—◆now changed sides!
en.text:
As for cutting down, his long sword was now in his left hand alone. A one-handed cut could not possibly break through the armor.

The advantage—◆now changed sides!

ja.html: 斬り下ろそうにも、獅子吼の長刀は今、左手一本で 保持されている。 　片手斬りでは到底、甲鉄を打ち破るなど叶わない。 　形勢の優劣は――――◆今、転じた！
ja.text:
斬り下ろそうにも、獅子吼の長刀は今、左手一本で
保持されている。
　片手斬りでは到底、甲鉄を打ち破るなど叶わない。

　形勢の優劣は――――◆今、転じた！

en.html:
Shishiku discarded the short sword, took his long sword in both hands again, and struck from above—

But I was faster!!
en.text:
Shishiku discarded the short sword, took his long sword in both hands again, and struck from above—

But I was faster!!

ja.html:
獅子吼が脇差を捨てる。
　太刀を両手に取り直し、上から襲う一撃――

　しかし、俺の方が早い!!
